children: The yen consolidates against other G-10 and Asian currencies as traders digest remarks from Japanese Finance Minister Katayama and BOJ Gov. Ueda. Katayama said the Japan-U.S. joint foreign exchange intervention efforts contribute to stability of global markets and economy, while declining to comment on specific currency levels, while BOJ Gov. Ueda said the central bank will discuss monetary policy with upside price risks in mind and is carefully watching foreign exchange movements as one risk factor to price outlook. The dollar is little changed at 160.15 yen and the euro is flat at Y185.62, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
